subject: Partner-led discovery / schedule technical deep dive (CloudBridge)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery / propose technical deep dive

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. CloudBridge is excited about Redwood's inference offering and we think a technical deep dive/demo with our cloud marketplace and engineering stakeholders would be the best next step.

Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
- 10m: short recap of integration goals (roles/access, marketplace listing workflow)
- 20–25m: technical deep dive — API integration, deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private), and SSO/KMS touchpoints
- 5–10m: next steps & mutual action items

Are you and Mateo available next week? Here are a few windows that work for our engineering leads:
- Tue 2027-06-15: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2027-06-16: 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 2027-06-17: 09:00–10:00 PT

If none of those fit, send a couple of times that do and I’ll coordinate. I attached a short agenda and will send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Partnerships Lead, CloudBridge
alex.turner@cloudbridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: RBW_CloudBridge_tech-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks Alex — this looks great. Mateo and I can do the Tue 6/15 10:00–11:00 PT slot. Mateo, can you confirm the engineering attendees on our side? We’ll include an infra/serving lead and a product engineer to cover rollout/marketplace integration questions.

Quick ask on scope so we prep:
- Are CloudBridge engineering folks primarily interested in the marketplace listing workflow (onboarding, billing mapping) or deeper runtime/quantization performance trade-offs?
- Any regulatory / compliance items we should prep (SOC2 evidence, data residency) to show during the call?

We’ll accept the calendar invite once sent.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
